summary.zh: 事情同时发生太多时，暂停一下，把队伍安排明白。
summary.en: Pause simultaneous problems long enough to organize the team.

rules.zh: 战斗平时实时进行，玩家随时暂停观察局面，并给不同角色或系统下令。解除暂停后命令在实时环境中执行；出现新的伤情、目标或故障，再暂停调整。暂停不自动解决问题，关键是它允许玩家处理并行任务。
rules.en: Combat runs in real time, but players can pause to inspect and order several units or systems. Orders execute after resuming; new injuries, targets or failures prompt another pause. Pausing supports parallel decisions rather than solving them automatically.

decisions.zh: 先救危险队员，还是先打断敌人的下一次攻击？
decisions.en: Rescue a threatened ally or interrupt the next enemy attack?

decisions.zh: 指令已经够用，要继续时间验证，还是还要调整其他角色？
decisions.en: Are the orders ready to test, or does another unit need attention?

effect.zh: 关键事件自动暂停能降低漏看风险，过多则会切碎节奏。
effect.en: Auto-pausing on key events prevents missed threats; too many interruptions fragment pacing.

effect.zh: 一次只能给一条更直观；多条队列提升规划能力也增加修改成本。
effect.en: Single orders are clear; longer queues enable planning but are harder to revise.

contrast.zh: 《超越光速》调度的是船员与整艘船的系统；《龙腾世纪：起源》主要协调小队角色的位置和能力。
contrast.en: FTL coordinates crew and ship systems; Dragon Age: Origins coordinates party positions and abilities.

combination.zh: 把船内供电预算接入暂停调度：切断生产设备，短暂把电力转给护盾。
combination.en: Connect power allocation to tactical pause: shut down production briefly to power shields.

setup.zh: 船舱着火，同时敌方武器即将蓄能完成。
setup.en: A room is burning while an enemy weapon nears a full charge.

action.zh: 暂停：派一人灭火，另一人维修护盾，并把自己的武器瞄准敌方武器室。
action.en: Pause: send one crew member to extinguish the fire, another to repair shields, and aim at the enemy weapon room.

result.zh: 恢复后各任务一起执行，你观察哪处问题仍未解决。
result.en: After resuming, tasks proceed together and you inspect what remains unresolved.

next.zh: 有人受伤时再暂停，把他换到安全位置继续修理。
next.en: Pause again when someone is injured and move them somewhere safer.

firstStep.zh: 用三个房间、两名角色、火灾和维修两类任务，先验证暂停下令到恢复执行。
firstStep.en: Use three rooms, two characters, fires and repairs to test pause-order-resume.

pitfall.zh: 暂停期间的目标变化或旧指令覆盖不清，会让玩家以为命令没生效。
pitfall.en: Unclear target changes or order replacement can look like ignored commands.

test.zh: 让试玩者处理两个同时发生的事件，检查他能否说清每个人恢复后会做什么。
test.en: Give testers two simultaneous events and ask what each unit will do after resuming.
